note: Which reviewed employer wording means which canonical answer. Value-free by construction: a form is a question and a meaning, never an answer, so this file belongs in the repository while the answers themselves never leave `.jobloom/`. Every question is recorded employer wording from the vendored corpus, named with the fixture it came from — none of it is paraphrased or invented, because a paraphrase would map a form no employer ships. Matching is exact on the normalized text; a semantic equivalent needs its own reviewed row. The three `contact.*` and `profile.*` meanings are here because the candidate's contact details exist only as one composite fact, which cannot fill a single field and cannot be split without a new snapshot and the re-approval of every resume version behind it.
